title: 第一卷 第160章 强敌来犯强敌逃窜第一卷 第159章 见了鬼了
slug: 失踪十年小师妹让全宗门跪下迎接
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：失踪十年，小师妹让全宗门跪下迎接第一卷第160章强敌来犯，强敌逃窜（..la）乔守玄忍不住揉了揉眼睛，重新看。
但是他横看竖看，对面山巅上那人的的确确就是洛还真的样子没错。
“等等！”
乔守玄大喊了一声。
四周原本看了他的眼神准备冲下去跟一叶宗这几个老东西打起来的长老动作一滞。
他们一脸不解地看向乔守玄。
乔守玄咽了口唾沫，抱着最后一丝希望，问在家这些长老。
“你们，能看见对面最高峰那个洞府门口不？那里是不是站了个小孩？”
乔守玄说的时候，心里在不断的祈祷。
希望是他的幻觉，希望是他的幻觉……他对洛还真有心理阴影，所以才产生了幻觉。
但是，理想很丰满，现实很骨感——
几个长老凝神仔细看了过去，然后给予乔守玄肯定的回答。
“宗主，是的。那里是站了个小孩儿！”
“还怪好看！”
“那里不是一叶宗宗主的洞府处吗，怎么让一个小孩子住了？一叶宗蔺阳私底下生的女儿？”
蔺阳。
一叶宗上一任宗主。
性格儒雅温柔，长得也是格外的俊美——所以才被鬼王看上掳走。
乔守玄心里最后的一丝幻想也消失了。
他一个人可能产生幻觉，可现在一群人都看见洛还真了，就不可能是幻觉。

“撤，不打了！”
乔守玄脸色难看地喊了一声。
然后也不管其他长老了，直接掐了个法诀，转身就跑。
速度之快，仿佛后面有鬼在撵。
乔守玄的这个举动，一下子让后面那几个已经做了充足战斗准备的长老丈二和尚摸不着头脑。
他们面面相觑了一会儿，便也掐诀御风，跟着乔守玄撤了。
没办法，谁让他是发号施令的宗主？
只是一众长老也不想这么不明不白地被他喊来，又莫名其妙地喊撤。
大家都不是什么小喽啰角色。
任何一个，走出去，都是要让一个地方抖三抖的大能！
因此，乔守玄今日这事儿办的，他们脸色皆是有些不太好。
于是在追上乔守玄后，纷纷开了口。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Missing for ten years, the junior sister asked the entire sect to kneel down to welcome the powerful enemy invading in Volume 1 Chapter 160, and the powerful enemy fled (..la) Qiao Shouxuan couldn't help but rub his eyes and read it again.
But he looked around and saw that the man on the top of the mountain opposite was indeed Luo Huan.
"Wait!"
Qiao Shouxuan shouted.
The elders around him who had looked at him and were about to rush down to fight with these old guys from the Yiye Sect were stagnant in their movements.
They looked at Qiao Shouxuan with puzzled faces.
Qiao Shouxuan swallowed, holding on to his last glimmer of hope, he asked the elders at home.
"Can you see the entrance to the cave on the highest peak opposite? Is there a child standing there?"
When Qiao Shouxuan said this, he was praying constantly in his heart.
Hope is his hallucination, hope is his hallucination... He really has a psychological shadow on Luo, so he has hallucinations.
However, the ideal is very full, and the reality is very skinny——
Several elders looked over carefully and then gave Qiao Shouxuan a positive answer.
"Sect Master, yes. There is a child standing there!"
"It's so pretty!"
"Isn't that the cave of the leader of the Yiye Sect? How come a child is allowed to live there? The daughter of Linyang of the Yiye Sect who was secretly born?"
Linyang.
The last sect leader of Yiye Sect.
He has an elegant and gentle personality, and is also exceptionally handsome - that's why he was taken abducted by the Ghost King.
The last trace of fantasy in Qiao Shouxuan's heart also disappeared.
He might have hallucinated alone, but now that a group of people have seen Luo Huan, it can't be a hallucination.
"Withdraw, stop fighting!"
Qiao Shouxuan shouted with an ugly expression.
Then he didn't care about the other elders, just made a magic spell, turned around and ran away.
The speed was so fast, it seemed like there was a ghost chasing him from behind.
Qiao Shouxuan's move immediately confused the elders and monks behind him who had made sufficient preparations for battle.
They looked at each other for a while, then they also said goodbye to Yufeng and followed Qiao Shouxuan to retreat.
There is no way, who makes him the leader who gives orders?
It's just that the elders didn't want to be called out by him so unclearly, and then called out inexplicably.
None of us are just minions.
Anyone who steps out will be able to make a place tremble three times!
Therefore, when Qiao Shouxuan did this today, they all looked a little unhappy.
So after catching up with Qiao Shouxuan, they all spoke.
